rv.q: With very little dialogue, extraordinary physical performances and infectious festive energy, this is a Christmas treat for all ages.
There are moments of seriously breathtaking beauty in Bull's design, which reaches impressively from a delightfully detailed domestic setting to an epic expanding tree and snowfall
Santa’s First Christmas might not give us the man himself in the bright red suit we all know and love, but it’s a cheerful and charming addition to the festive season.
Beautifully choreographed, musically engaging and genuinely heartwarming, this festive production reminds us that those who spend their lives caring for others deserve to be cared for, too.

cn.t: Critics largely embrace this festive dance adaptation at the Unicorn Theatre, praising its joyful spirit and magical movement, though one dissenting voice tempers the enthusiasm.
